newsitem.title: USA: American offers cargo rate discounts.
newsitem.headline: American offers cargo rate discounts.

text.p: American Airlines said it is offering cargo rate discounts averaging 45 percent on domestic narrowbody and transcontinental flights as well as some international flights through February 28.

The carrier said the "Full Speed AAhead" discounts are meant to help rebuild traffic lost in the runup to Saturday's strike by 9,000 pilots which was called off minutes after it started after President Bill Clinton ordered a 60-day cooling-off period between the parties.
Fears that an all-out strike by the pilots would ground the carrier caused many regular American freight customers to move bookings to other airlines.

The discounts, which also apply to all Puerto Rico flights, are a means "to apologize to our loyal customers for any inconvenience they may have experienced these last few days," said Mark Najarian, AA Cargo's vice-president of sales.
